description: Eleven ES/EN searches included national, local and regional terms, sector prompts, and four week-bounded windows. Results are pooled/noisy and do not establish comprehensive coverage; results sampled Los Ríos and Tarapacá and student activity but not every region or sector equally.
follow_up: Further regional archives, local radio and source databases required; no exhaustive/no-event inference.

description: Feb23 Mapuche community demonstration at Statkraft entrance is documented by local media/INDH accounts, but none gives attendance. At least five injured cannot establish ≥50. Candidate remains pending_threshold.
follow_up: Seek another contemporaneous local report or organizer account with a crowd estimate.

description: Stories say the demonstration opposed a hydroelectric project by Norwegian company Statkraft. They do not establish a demand directed to Chilean state policy or institutions. Eligibility remains unresolved even if attendance later meets threshold.
follow_up: Need direct evidence of a demand to Chilean state authority/permit policy; do not infer solely from state ownership of project company.

description: Cooperativa and Paislobo quote/relay INDH officials/social statement concerning police action and injuries; these are not independent crowd-size sources and Paislobo appears to reproduce INDH material. The local Diario de Valdivia body also includes the INDH account.
follow_up: Do not treat the three publications as independent corroboration of attendance or origin.

description: Feb28 search results report proposed March 9 student march and police preparation. No public gathering in February is established by these announcements. Actual occurrence/onset belongs to March review; do not code announcement as event.
follow_up: Verify the executed March 9 action with event-date reporting in March dossier.

topic: January 30 security mobilization and possible separate blockade
description: Iquique/Alto Hospicio security march was held Jan30, despite Infobae’s Feb1 publication. Infobae also mentions a road blockade separately; exact site/date/attendance linkage for that action is not resolved, and no February continuation is evidenced.
follow_up: Do not transfer the march to February or merge a blockade without source-level event linkage.

description: Searches about Feb2023 forest fires and labor/health/education did not produce another verified February public gathering that met both threshold and own-Chile state-target criteria. Search limits and inaccessible local reporting mean this is not a zero-event finding.
